AI Overview
Mr. Flip most commonly refers to a popular 2D physics-based browser game or a historic 1909 silent comedy short film. 
Wikipedia
 +1
1. Mr. Flip (Browser Game)
Genre: Ragdoll physics, parkour, and stunt arcade game. 
Gameplay: You launch a gymnast or character into the air, time your rotation and flips, and try to land upright inside a designated target zone. 
Mr Flip
 +2
Features: It includes 8 levels with 10 jumps each (spanning environments like frontyards, construction sites, and playgrounds) plus an endless Arcade mode. 
Where to Play: You can play it for free in a web browser at Mr Flip. 
2. Mr. Flip (1909 Film)
Genre: 4-minute silent slapstick comedy. 
IMDb
 +1
Director & Cast: Directed by Gilbert M. "Broncho Billy" Anderson and starring Ben Turpin as the title character. 
Wikipedia
Significance: Known for featuring the first-recorded cinematic instance of a character getting a pie thrown in their face (alongside shaving cream and seltzer) after flirting with women around town.
